userProfile.title: User Profile
userProfile.description: User profile containing authentication details, role, and security clearance level.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

clearanceLevel.description: Security clearance level for accessing gated blogs.

blogAccessPolicy.title: Blog Access Control Policy
blogAccessPolicy.description: Granular Firebase access control rule specifying required clearance and role restrictions per blog post.

postId.description: Unique identifier of the blog post.

slug.description: URL slug of the blog article.

requiredClearance.description: Minimum clearance required to view this blog.

allowedRoles.description: Comma-separated or serialized list of allowed RBAC roles.

updatedBy.description: UID of the security architect or admin who modified this policy.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when policy was last updated.

accessRequest.title: Article Access Approval Request
accessRequest.description: Access approval request submitted by a user to the administrator (munish.world@gmail.com) for reviewing and granting article access.

id.description: Unique identifier for the access request.

postTitle.description: The title of the requested article.

userEmail.description: Email address of the requesting user.

userName.description: Display name of the requesting user.

requestedClearance.description: Clearance level required to unlock the article.

reason.description: Business justification for accessing the classified post.

status.description: Current status of the access request.

reviewedBy.description: Admin email who approved or rejected the request.

userArticleGrant.title: User Article Specific Grant
userArticleGrant.description: Explicit individual article access grant approved by the administrator.

postId.description: Article ID unlocked for the user.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profiles with assigned security clearances and RBAC roles.

/blogAccessPolicies/{postId}.description: Stores granular access control policies and clearance levels for each blog.

/accessRequests/{requestId}.description: Stores article access requests routed to administrator munish.world@gmail.com for approval.

/userArticleGrants/{grantId}.description: Stores individual approved article access grants.
